• Knowledge of Essbase, Visual Basic & Macros is an advantage
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• 4+ years of relevant FP&A experience preferred
• Financial Services experience preferred
• Candidates with strong Financial Analysis / Planning & Forecasting backgrounds
